changes: Implemented modular Prompt Envelope paths, production dispatch persistence, observe-only complex-role budgets, real serialized dual-provider A/B evidence, and invariant checks for five complex roles. Because v3 showed worse modular recall, real Claude/Codex production defaults remain immutable legacy; modular full-envelope is explicit audit-only.
usage: Normal role dispatch requires no change and uses legacy-full-context safely. For audit evidence run node packages/main/dist/tasks/story6-acceptance-transcript.js; it separates PRODUCTION_DEFAULT from AUDIT_DISPATCH and prints budget, campaign and invariant facts.
expectedOutcome: Five complex roles have a real production-bound modular audit path, nonblocking budget observations, trustworthy A/B receipts, and preserved delivery/scope/authority/signature semantics, while rejected modular rollout cannot become the production default.
actualTranscript: Fresh 46-command routine validation passed. The real-machine acceptance audit transcript emitted five PRODUCTION_DEFAULT legacy lines, five AUDIT_DISPATCH full-envelope lines with auditOnly=true/canMintReviewEvidence=false/persisted=true, bound bytes/estimatedTokens/limitBytes budget rows, five valid adverse campaign rows, 72-receipt INCONCLUSIVE summary, and real invariant consumer outcomes.
outcomeDiff: The migration and audit mechanism matches the expected outcome. The modular arm did not meet non-regression acceptance, so production correctly remains legacy-default and the experiment remains INCONCLUSIVE/adverse rather than rollout-ready.
limitations: Codex cacheCreationInputTokens was unavailable for 36 cells. Modular recall regressed from 24/24 to 20/24 and false positives rose from 0 to 1, so baselineAccepted=false, recallNonRegressionClaim=false, enforceReady=false, and Story 7 remains absent.
pitfalls: Closeout exposed host-render drift, process-fact mirror drift, and initially aggregate-only acceptance output. The final transcript separates production from audit, binds budget metrics, and uses real consumer outcomes. Do not rerun the 72-cell campaign unless inputs materially change.
